summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built and benchmarked computer vision detection pipelines in PyTorch and TensorRT on NVIDIA Jetson, cutting YOLO inference latency 5.2× (56.7→10.9 ms) for on-device edge deployment. Trained YOLO detection models (83% mAP@50, ~0.85 mAP50) and built audio pipelines including a Whisper-style ASR from scratch (15% WER) and faster-whisper speech-to-text.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized decoder embedding layer accordingly.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing, and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (camera range-gate + gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm) for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (Type=simple, auto-restart with backoff, non-root user/group isolation, environment-file-based config) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device WebSocket registration; configured XRDP for remote desktop administration of the headless Jetson.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) with SoftmaxFocalLoss + ParsingRelationLoss; integrated into an adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Achieved 15% WER on the NPTEL 2020 Indian-English dataset while reducing preprocessing latency via optimized tokenization.

Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline: 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder, 4-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention, trained on 1,000 Indian-English samples (NPTEL 2020) achieving training loss ~0.51.
